en: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “Do Not Destroy.” A poem by David.

zh: 大衛的金詩，交與伶長。調用休要毀壞。

p.src: 1  Do you indeed speak righteousness, silent ones? Do you judge blamelessly, you sons of men?

en: Do you indeed speak righteousness, silent ones? Do you judge blamelessly, you sons of men?
u.src: 1  Do you indeed speak righteousness, silent ones? Do you judge blamelessly, you sons of men?

p.src: 2  No, in your heart you plot injustice. You measure out the violence of your hands on the earth.

en: No, in your heart you plot injustice. You measure out the violence of your hands on the earth.
u.src: 2  No, in your heart you plot injustice. You measure out the violence of your hands on the earth.

p.src: 3  The wicked go astray from the womb. They are wayward as soon as they are born, speaking lies.

en: The wicked go astray from the womb. They are wayward as soon as they are born, speaking lies.
u.src: 3  The wicked go astray from the womb. They are wayward as soon as they are born, speaking lies.

p.src: 4  Their poison is like the poison of a snake, like a deaf cobra that stops its ear,

en: Their poison is like the poison of a snake, like a deaf cobra that stops its ear,
u.src: 4  Their poison is like the poison of a snake, like a deaf cobra that stops its ear,

p.src: 5  which doesn’t listen to the voice of charmers, no matter how skillful the charmer may be.

en: which doesn’t listen to the voice of charmers, no matter how skillful the charmer may be.
u.src: 5  which doesn’t listen to the voice of charmers, no matter how skillful the charmer may be.

p.src: 6  Break their teeth, God, in their mouth. Break out the great teeth of the young lions, LORD.

en: Break their teeth, God, in their mouth. Break out the great teeth of the young lions, LORD.
u.src: 6  Break their teeth, God, in their mouth. Break out the great teeth of the young lions, LORD.

p.src: 7  Let them vanish like water that flows away. When they draw the bow, let their arrows be made blunt.

en: Let them vanish like water that flows away. When they draw the bow, let their arrows be made blunt.
u.src: 7  Let them vanish like water that flows away. When they draw the bow, let their arrows be made blunt.

p.src: 8  Let them be like a snail which melts and passes away, like the stillborn child, who has not seen the sun.

en: Let them be like a snail which melts and passes away, like the stillborn child, who has not seen the sun.
u.src: 8  Let them be like a snail which melts and passes away, like the stillborn child, who has not seen the sun.

p.src: 9  Before your pots can feel the heat of the thorns, he will sweep away the green and the burning alike.

en: Before your pots can feel the heat of the thorns, he will sweep away the green and the burning alike.
u.src: 9  Before your pots can feel the heat of the thorns, he will sweep away the green and the burning alike.

p.src: 10  The righteous shall rejoice when he sees the vengeance. He shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked,

en: The righteous shall rejoice when he sees the vengeance. He shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked,
u.src: 10  The righteous shall rejoice when he sees the vengeance. He shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked,

p.src: 11  so that men shall say, “Most certainly there is a reward for the righteous. Most certainly there is a God who judges the earth.”

en: so that men shall say, “Most certainly there is a reward for the righteous. Most certainly there is a God who judges the earth.”
u.src: 11  so that men shall say, “Most certainly there is a reward for the righteous. Most certainly there is a God who judges the earth.”
